ASE A6 Electrical Practice Test
29. The parking brake warning light in the diagram above does not illuminate when the parking brake is engaged. The fluid level switch functions normally. Which of the following is causing this condition?
- A. An open at point A.
- B. An open at point B.
- C. An open at point C.
